top_issues: Color legend items (On-chain, Reserve, Secured, Hub promise) use tiny squares with low visual separation between emerald and teal green nuances.
Instant capacity line 'Instant: send up to $182.99, receive up to $23.30' lacks visual prominence despite being vital for payment success.
fixes: Increase font-weight and dot contrast for breakdown legend categories under the headline balance.
Add a pill container or subtle background badge to the 'Instant: send/receive' capacity row.

top_issues: In the Accounts card, '+95.00 owes you' doesn't explicitly state whether this is collateralized or pure credit promise without tapping into detail.
The bottom action '+ Open account' has low contrast against the card surface.
fixes: Add a two-tone mini badge to '+95.00' indicating the collateral vs credit split directly in the account row.
Give '+ Open account' a subtle border or elevated surface tint.

top_issues: Full entity address hex string below H2 takes vertical space without being easily verifiable by eye.
Primary action CTA 'Pay 25.00 USDC' is partially cut off at the viewport bottom on default scroll.
fixes: Truncate recipient 0x hex with an inline copy icon to save 28px vertical space.
Pin the primary CTA button to the bottom sticky bar above the home indicator.

top_issues: The route selector cards repeat 'You -> H1 -> H2' without explaining why the second 3-hop route exists or what its trade-off is.
'Delivery Instant Change' link seems redundant with the 2 ROUTES card group immediately beneath it.
fixes: Label route options with clear operational rationale (e.g. 'Cheapest / Direct' vs 'Alternate')
Remove the redundant 'Delivery: Instant Change' line or wire it directly to route sheet.

top_issues: The background backdrop behind the sheet reveals balance numbers that clash visually with the top edge of the sheet.
Elapsed duration 'in 9 s' is colored green, which might be mistaken for an affirmative status rather than a timing metric.
fixes: Increase sheet modal backdrop dimming opacity from 0.4 to 0.7.
Render settlement duration 'in 9 s' in secondary muted grey (#94A3B8) instead of emerald.

top_issues: Bottom action buttons 'Copy receipt' and 'Done' are visually balanced equally, failing to prioritize dismiss vs export.
Truncated proof '0x921f4bda...deb9' does not have an explicit tap-to-copy target.
fixes: Make 'Copy receipt' an outlined button and keep 'Done' filled primary.
Add an inline copy icon beside the proof hash.

top_issues: QR code container has stark white padding that creates extreme visual glare in mobile dark mode.
Capacity info '45.50 capacity via H1' is placed beside Amount optional where it can be missed by first-time receivers.
fixes: Use a warm off-white/subtle parchment container with softened corner radius for the QR code.
Elevate 'Inbound Capacity: 45.50 USDC' into a dedicated helper pill below the token selector.

top_issues: Full entity ID 64-character hex block is unreadable and intimidating for ordinary users.
Three competing copy actions: 'Copy invoice', 'Copy link', 'Copy xln:// app link' create choice friction.
fixes: Group copy actions into a primary 'Share invoice link' and secondary 'Copy raw id/uri' dropdown.
Format entity hex with middle ellipsis and checksum badge.

top_issues: The collateral slider under 'Prepare to receive' introduces bilateral channel mechanics right into a standard swap flow.
High decimal precision on needed collateral ('0.039191 WETH') clutters mobile glanceability.
fixes: Collapse 'Prepare to receive / collateral setup' into an expandable advanced drawer defaulted to auto-safe.
Round display amounts on the slider indicators to 4 decimal places with full precision on long-press.

top_issues: Dense order book rows with 4 decimal places require very deliberate horizontal scanning on narrow screens.
The spread indicator 'spread 1.0000 USDC · 0.04% · last 2,500.5000' blends into the table divider.
fixes: Increase vertical spacing between book rows from 4px to 6px and differentiate font weight between price and depth.
Add a distinct tinted pill background to the mid-market spread bar.

top_issues: Five header action buttons create an asymmetrical grid with an awkward empty cell on the right.
Legend text under the header is dense and small on mobile.
fixes: Align header actions into a balanced 4-column row or 2x3 grid with consistent iconography.
Convert the color legend into interactive tap-targets that highlight the corresponding segment in the bar below.

top_issues: The legal/cryptographic explainer at the bottom is small low-contrast text that is hard to read in sunlight.
'Show 1 empty lane · USDT' looks like an inactive label rather than a disclosure trigger.
fixes: Give the explanation card a subtle security badge icon and 13px high-contrast text.
Style 'Show empty lanes' as a standard disclosure button with chevron.

top_issues: Filter pills at the top scroll horizontally offscreen with no gradient fade indicator.
Each transaction row has an absolute scale bar beneath the icon, but without a label it looks like an underline decoration.
fixes: Add subtle edge masks to horizontal category filter tabs.
Add a tiny micro-tooltip or header hint indicating that row bar lengths represent proportional economic size.

top_issues: 'Frames: 2 committed entries' doesn't allow expanding to inspect the specific frame state proofs.
Modal close 'x' icon is small and placed close to the device sheet pull handle.
fixes: Make '2 committed entries' an expandable disclosure revealing frame heights and root hashes.
Increase touch target for the close button to 44x44px.

top_issues: The 'Dollars per pixel' slider is technical; users without mental models of proportional visualization will be confused.
Toggles for 'On-chain wallet', 'Reserve', and 'Accounts' do not make clear whether toggling them off hides them or disables them.
fixes: Provide a live visual preview bar right inside the scale slider card.
Change toggle subtext to 'Show on home dashboard' to clarify visibility vs protocol state.

top_issues: 'At this scale' table displays raw pixel values (10 px, 100 px, 1,000 px, 10,000 px) which is developer telemetry rather than user insight.
'Forget vault' is placed alongside 'Reveal recovery phrase' and 'Lock' with insufficient spacing.
fixes: Replace raw pixel numbers with sample preview bars of recognizable currency denominations.
Separate 'Forget vault' into a distinct destructive action section at the bottom with confirmation flow.

top_issues: Two identical 3-column rows (FROM: Wallet/Reserve/Account and TO: Wallet/Reserve/Account) take enormous vertical space.
Selecting destination requires cross-referencing which account is selected in the dropdown below.
fixes: Use an interactive matrix or unified transfer stepper ('Transfer from [Pill] to [Pill]').
Auto-populate destination account selector based on the active channel connection.

top_issues: 'Add to batch' action is present without context on where the batch queue lives or how it executes.
Recipient entity field 'leave empty for yourself' is confusing in self-custody reallocation.
fixes: Hide 'Recipient entity' unless an explicit 'Transfer to third party' checkbox is checked.
Show an indicator badge on 'Add to batch' showing currently queued operations.

top_issues: Grid of 5 management cards has an orphaned single card ('Ownership') spanning the bottom left.
'Where your money stands' card repeats the home screen breakdown without immediate drilldown.
fixes: Make navigation cards a clean 2-column or list view with chevron cues.
Make rows in 'Where your money stands' tap-targets linking directly to Sovereignty and Move screens.

top_issues: 'Depository may pull 0.00' is repeated across all tokens without explaining allowance mechanics.
'Move into reserve' CTA inside the token list card disrupts row scanning.
fixes: Replace 'Depository may pull 0.00' with an explicit 'Allowance: 0.00' and an 'Approve' link.
Move the 'Move into reserve' action to a primary bottom bar button.

top_issues: Four action buttons stacked at the bottom have ambiguous operational differences (Receive vs on-chain vs reserve).
Disclaimers on collateral shortfall appear as disabled states without clear next steps.
fixes: Consolidate inbound deposit destinations into an explicit radio group above a single 'Confirm' button.
Clarify faucet mechanics if this is a testnet-only UI.

top_issues: Token selection cards are laid out horizontally and vertically in an inconsistent grid.
Lend/Borrow segmented switch is placed halfway down the form rather than at the top level.
fixes: Move Lend/Borrow switch to the very top header level.
Use a compact horizontal segmented picker for Token selection.

top_issues: Interest rate input asks for raw 'basis points' (100) which causes cognitive fatigue for retail lenders.
Hub pool stats at the bottom (Available, Borrowed, Active principal) are 0.00 without historical utilization context.
fixes: Allow direct percentage input (e.g. 1.00%) with basis points as secondary caption.
Add utilization percentage indicator to the H1 Pool card.

top_issues: 'Lazy (hash of its board)' is jargon without actionable explanation for DAO treasurers.
No direct button to export board cryptographic evidence or initiate a signer change.
fixes: Add a plain-English tooltip: 'Deterministic identity generated from current signer configuration'.
Provide an explicit 'Export board proof' action.

top_issues: The distinction between '$40.00 Enforceable right now' and the $97.99 'Hub promise' is stark but needs an immediate 1-tap 'Securitize' action.
Text explanation of Green vs Violet is long and dense.
fixes: Add a direct 'Move to reserve / Collateralize' button directly below the risk summary bar.
Format the Green vs Violet explanation as bulleted key-value highlights.

top_issues: 'Can dispute without asking: 1 of 1' does not explain what happens when the dispute is triggered.
'Save evidence bundle' button saves locally but provides no visible verification check or cloud/air-gapped export confirmation.
fixes: Add a small link 'How dispute arbitration works' with timeline breakdown.
Show a toast or modal previewing the bundle signature hashes when tapped.

overall.verdict: The xln mobile-dark interface establishes an exceptionally rigorous standard of financial transparency, making the subtle boundaries between on-chain reserves, collateralized accounts, and unsecured credit visually concrete through disciplined typography and absolute-scale bars. However, its uncompromising cryptographic honesty occasionally burdens casual payment and swap flows with protocol-level mechanics that should be tucked into progressive disclosures.
priority_fixes: Simplify Pay and Receive screens by truncating long entity hex IDs and separating invoice link sharing from protocol-level uri payloads.
Collapse channel collateral configuration inside the Swap flow into an advanced drawer so retail users are not blocked by liquidity provisioning.
Pin primary transaction action buttons (Pay, Move, Swap) to a fixed bottom action bar on mobile viewports to prevent cutoff.
Harmonize the Move screen layout by replacing the double 3-column matrix with a streamlined Source-to-Destination stepper.
Introduce an explicit 1-tap 'Collateralize' or 'Settle on-chain' shortcut wherever hub-promise counterparty risk is exposed.
